review_title: Very easy for first time SIP
review_text: Started my first 1000 rupees monthly SIP in Nifty 50 index fund. The UPI autopay setup took less than 2 minutes.

review_title: Mandate debited but failed in app
review_text: My bank debited 2000 rupees for my SIP yesterday but app still shows order pending and support is not replying!
3 mahine se SIP chal rahi hai par portfolio minus me dikha raha hai. Bank FD hi acchi thi yahan loss ho raha hai.

review_title: Bachon ki padhai ke liye shuru kiya
review_text: Bacho ki higher education ke liye 15 saal ka plan banaya hai. App UI simple hai aur track karna asan hai.
No commission direct funds. NPS and mutual fund SIP management is seamless without any distributor cut.
e-mandate got rejected due to signature mismatch. Wish there was clearer error message instead of generic failure.

review_title: Good for stocks and MF combined
review_text: Setup my monthly SIP easily. Demat holding statement reflects correctly within T+2 days.
App did not trigger reminder before SIP date and bank deducted 590 rupees bounce charges for insufficient balance.
